accepted.title: Infimal k-dilation in a homotopy class
accepted.text: For a smooth map F between Riemannian manifolds, dil_k(F)=sup_x‖ΛᵏdF_x‖, the maximum factor by which its differential expands k-dimensional volume. For closed Riemannian manifolds X,Y, integer k≥1 and a homotopy class α of maps X→Y, determine inf{dil_k(F):F is a smooth representative of α}. In particular, characterize when this infimum is zero.
